IMPORTANT RESEARCH NOTE (per task instructions): searched specifically for a dedicated 'human-in-the-loop' feature for Cortex Agents. docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/cortex-agents (the main Cortex Agents page) does NOT mention permission policies, always_ask/always_allow, or human-in-the-loop at all. The real, documented mechanism lives specifically on the code execution tool's own doc page (cortex-agents-code-execution-tool) and the coding-agent (Cortex Code) page, as a permission_policy field under tool_resources for the code_execution / code_toolset_all tool types, with always_ask (default) and always_allow values. This is NOT a universal, named 'human-in-the-loop' feature spanning all Cortex Agent tool types (e.g. Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search tool calls have no equivalent documented field) — the lesson is written to say so explicitly rather than implying broader coverage than what's documented.
